---
name: Add a selection or mentor
about: Add a student selected into a programme, or a mentor
labels: content, good first issue
---

**Who**
Name, and the programme + year (GSoC / LFX / C4GT / SoB / Outreachy).

**Organisation that selected them**

**One sentence on what they actually built**
Specific beats impressive. "Merged a parser fix into OpenCRE", not "made great contributions".

**Proof link**
The project page, the merged work, or the official announcement. Must state what
the entry claims.

**Consent**
- [ ] This person has been asked and agreed to appear on the public site by name.

> Entries without consent are filtered out in code and will not render. Please do
> not tick this on someone else's behalf.
